services.teknik_servis_desc: Quick response and expert technical support in case of breakdowns.
services.teknik_servis_long: The Nokta Dizayn technical service team responds quickly to refrigeration system failures. Our field team of experienced engineers and technicians identifies the root cause and provides permanent solutions.
services.bakim_desc: Extend system life with periodic maintenance and preventive service programs.
services.bakim_long: Periodic maintenance plans ensure the refrigeration system operates at maximum efficiency. Planned maintenance prevents unexpected breakdowns, optimizes energy consumption and extends equipment life.
services.yedek_parca_desc: Original and alternative spare part supply with fast delivery.
services.yedek_parca_long: Ensure continuous operation of your equipment with a wide range of spare parts kept in stock. Compressors, fan motors, thermostats, door gaskets and many more parts are available for quick supply.
services.garanti_desc: Fast resolution process for malfunctions and problems under warranty.
services.garanti_long: All Nokta Dizayn products are delivered with a warranty certificate. Priority intervention and parts replacement are performed for failures within warranty coverage. Warranty terms and duration are determined per product.
services.talep_desc: Create a quick service request with our online form.
services.talep_long: Fill out our online service request form and our team will reach you as soon as possible. Priority routing is made based on failure type, product information and urgency level.
talep_features: Option to attach photos and files
services.enerji_desc: Analyze the energy performance of your existing system and discover savings opportunities.
services.enerji_long: Our field expert team measures and analyzes the energy consumption of your existing refrigeration system. Identifies system inefficiencies and reports improvement recommendations. Reduce your energy costs with the optimizations implemented.
services.retrofit_desc: Modernize your existing equipment: more efficient, more reliable.
services.retrofit_long: Modernize your system by updating key components rather than completely replacing old refrigeration equipment. Compressor replacement, control system update and refrigerant conversion are among the main retrofit options.

surdurulebilirlik_page.t03_desc: Reliable cooling protects food safety and product quality while reducing spoilage losses.
surdurulebilirlik_page.t04_desc: With low energy consumption and long maintenance intervals, total cost of ownership is optimized.
surdurulebilirlik_page.t05_desc: Equipment made with industrial-grade materials and quality control delivers reliable performance for years.
surdurulebilirlik_page.t06_desc: Energy management and maintenance efficiency are provided together with smart control platforms.
surdurulebilirlik_page.t07_desc: Periodic maintenance plans preserve equipment design efficiency and prevent unexpected failures.
surdurulebilirlik_page.t08_desc: Prepare your system for the future with equipment compatible with new low-GWP refrigerants.

anahtar_teslim.title: One Contract, One Responsibility, Full Delivery.
anahtar_teslim.body_1: In traditional store projects, the customer bears the burden of coordinating between designers, equipment suppliers, installation firms and maintenance providers.
anahtar_teslim.body_2: Nokta Dizayn eliminates this burden. From concept decision to final commissioning: one contract, one point of contact, one responsibility.
anahtar_teslim.b1_text: Concept, design, engineering, production, logistics, installation and commissioning; all under the same project contract. No coordination complexity between suppliers.
anahtar_teslim.b2_text: The project timeline is set at the start and managed end-to-end by the same engineering team. Delays arising from independent schedules of different firms are eliminated.
anahtar_teslim.b3_text: The turnkey model minimizes budget uncertainty. You work with a clear project cost — no additional suppliers, coordination costs, or surprise items.

tek_paydas.nd_03: Clear schedule commitment, single team ownership
tek_paydas.nd_04: All disciplines integrated in one engineering language
tek_paydas.nd_05: After-sales service from the same umbrella, same team
tek_paydas.nd_06: Continuous technical memory from project start to finish

muhendislik_altyapisi.title: Multi-Disciplinary Engineering Under One Roof
muhendislik_altyapisi.subtitle: Nokta Dizayn's project management relies on in-house engineering teams, not outsourcing. This ensures technical decisions are made in real time at the same table at every project stage.
muhendislik_altyapisi.d1_text: Refrigeration load calculation, product-based temperature management and energy performance analysis are carried out by in-house refrigeration engineers. Each project is modeled according to real operating conditions, based on site-specific data rather than standard coefficients.
muhendislik_altyapisi.d2_text: Equipment installation, structural support solutions and in-store technical infrastructure are engineered with mechanical discipline. Load capacity, vibration and load distribution are calculated from the start.
muhendislik_altyapisi.d3_text: Panel, cable routing, load calculation and energy monitoring system are designed within the same project scope with electrical engineering infrastructure. Energy efficiency reporting is included in project delivery documents.
muhendislik_altyapisi.d4_text: Customer flow, shelf layout, visual presentation and store identity are combined in a single drawing set along with refrigerated display systems and store equipment. Since design and engineering progress simultaneously, revisions are resolved at minimum cost.
muhendislik_altyapisi.d5_text: Each project is managed by an assigned project manager from start to delivery. Single point of contact for the client, single coordinator on site. Transparent reporting of project status, schedule and open items is part of the standard process.
muhendislik_altyapisi.d6_text: Quality control protocols are applied at every stage from production line to site. After site installation, systematic commissioning tests are performed; delivery documentation and operational training are provided to the client.
